title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode21 MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All right, here goes! I'm going to open it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-A-Another rejection! Noooooo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Let me see that email!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-They really rejected you. What the hell are the reviewers thinking?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's too bad. Oh, I know. What do you say we get some udon on the way home? I know a really good place near the station.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for worrying about me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even after all the help you both gave me... *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you so down? This isn't like you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. She's right. You're the idol who was able to cheer us all up, remember?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Something like this isn't going to make you give up, is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course not! One more failure is nothing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm going to dedicate myself even more to becoming an idol capable of giving hope to others!
More, more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's better! That's the Minori we know!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought I'd find you all here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great timing, Haruka. We were just about to start practice.
Would you help us out?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori just got a rejection letter, so we're going to be working her extra hard today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, you failed the MoriPro audition?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, y-yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But I'm not giving up!
I'll work harder until I can be an idol like you, Haruka! More, more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, I have a suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think about being idols together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We start a brand new idol group and work as a team.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Where did this come from?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We all have the same dream.
The dream of being idols who give hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think we'd be able to give people even more hope if we were to team up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of us together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I like it. Working together would be encouraging. And I'm sure we would be able to put on wonderful shows by helping each other.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course, if Airi agrees to it, that is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Are you sure about this? I'm sure any agency would jump at the chance to have you. You'd be able to start immediately.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If I'm going to be an idol again, I want it to be with the ones who gave me back my hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... You look like you've already made up your mind.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
If that's what you want, then sure.
Working with you sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm not going to go easy on you just because you're the famous Haruka Kiritani! You'd better be ready!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you're going to team up with Momoi and Hinomori?! W-Wow! You're going to be the best idol group out there for sure!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah! I...I'm witnessing history in the making! C-Can I claim the title of your very first fan?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. What are you talking about, Minori?
When I said I want to work together, I meant you too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By together, you mean...you want me...to join you? What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why do you look so confused? Of course we do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. Nothing starts without you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But I've never even passed the second round of an audition.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You gave us hope, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You gave us more hope than anyone. You gave it to us just as an idol would.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you really sure you're okay with someone like me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka... Momoi... Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm still nowhere near as good at singing and dancing as all of you are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've been making us help you practice all this time and you're still saying that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll just make up for each other's shortcomings like we did when we were up on stage in the other world.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right, Minori. I'd like to sing one more time... No, I want to sing with everyone from now on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They all believe that I can do this. If we're all together, I'm sure we'll be able to give hope to so many people!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I promise to work more and more to catch up to all of you soon!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great! Now that's decided, we should think up a name for the group!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? We're picking one now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! This sort of thing calls for motivation and passion! What about you, Minori? Any ideas for a name?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Well, um... How about Delivering Hope for Tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess it does have a certain idol-like ring to it, but it's just a bit too literal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, we could use the English word TOMORROW, and maybe we could use the word FIGHT to show our determination.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We don't want it to sound like we're getting ready to battle!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I kind of like Minori's habit of saying more, more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even if things don't go your way, you keep working more and more. It really conveys your unwillingness to give up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More, more? Well, how about MORE MORE FIGHT!?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's with you and the word fight? You think this is a martial arts club?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think about MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. It kind of makes it sounds like we're reaching up toward our dream of being idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're right. Though we've had our share of difficulties along the way. We even gave up on being idols.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I like it! This time, we're going to clear all of the hurdles in our way, together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I like it, too. That settles it then.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: From this moment on, we are MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then let's start our first official group practice!
Are you ready, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! I'm ready, Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, now that we're all part of the same group, maybe you should start using our first names.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? O-Oh, then Airi and Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. It's a little embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, stop spacing out! Let's get to work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, r-right! I promise to work hard!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ...Hehe.
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku! The show's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, hold on, Rin. Your ribbon is a bit crooked.
There, that's better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All right, let's do our best today to give more, more happiness back to our fans!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪
